name: Elmarma Carmine
original_name: エルマールマ・カーマイン
source:
Carmine (her real given name being Elmarma) hails from a family of nobles who owns land famous for its orange groves. She was the valedictorian of the Copeland Wyvern Royal Academy's twenty-third graduating class.

She's an unlucky girl who always attracts unwanted attention from guys she has no interest in, but who also struggles to get the guys she likes to return her unrequited feelings.

She exposed her vulnerable side to Ichiro when she lost to him in aerial combat training, and ever since, she's had a soft spot for him. Carmine herself won't admit that, however.

[From Frontwing's [url=https://www.facebook.com/FrontwingINT/]official Facebook page[/url]]
